channel.title: NetCage releases
channel.description: Release notes for NetCage, the per-app Android firewall.

item.title: NetCage 1.5.0
item.description: Turn on [two-step sign-in](./two-step-sign-in.md) under Settings ▸ Account ▸ Security: an authenticator code after Google sign-in, plus recovery codes that each work once. Settings ▸ About ▸ Get NetCage lists this app, the website and the documentation. Wording fixes now arrive as signed files when you open NetCage and apply from the next start; new features and permissions still need a new APK.

item.title: NetCage 1.4.0
item.description: Account now shows your plan, your backup versions (restore any of them) and the Cage Packs you published (delete any of them). Family invitations go out from Settings ▸ Account ▸ Family. Ask NetCage answers from the documentation on the Help screen. NetCage tells you when a new version is required, and Update opens the signed APK download on the NetCage website. The launcher icon now draws the cage bars.
